Class SshClientApp

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
java.awt.Window
java.awt.Frame
javax.swing.JFrame
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientApp
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, RootPaneContainer, WindowConstants, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host, SshConnectionPanel.Listener, TerminalSession.Host
public class SshClientApp extends JFrame implements SshConnectionPanel.Listener, TerminalSession.Host, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host
The SshClientApp window is the dark SSH client. JediTerm is the terminal widget inside each pane. The frame holds the FoldingPanel, the SshConnectionPanel, the TerminalSession list, and the AetherisNotebookPanel. Connect and disconnect go through SshSessionController. The window uses the Metal look from SshClientTheme. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshClientApp

  • Constructor Details

    • SshClientApp

      public SshClientApp(SshClientProperties properties, SshClientTheme theme, AetherisYaml yaml)
      The constructor builds the window. A null yaml, or a blank title, uses AetherisYaml.DEFAULT_TITLE. Any other title is trimmed. A null yaml is replaced with a new AetherisYaml. The notebook, the first TerminalSession, and the connection panel are created here. The close operation does nothing until the confirm dialog runs. The SSH tab is enabled. The Aetheris tab starts disabled. The status word starts as est. tokens: 1. The token timer repeats every 200 milliseconds. The resize timer waits 400 milliseconds and does not repeat. The minimum size is 640 by 480. A saved frame that meets a screen is restored. Any other open uses seatOpeningFrame(). A saved maximized flag sets both maximize bits. A stored Aetheris product tab sets restoreAetheris.
      Parameters:
      properties - The persistence store.
      theme - The dark painter.
      yaml - The Aetheris settings. A null value is replaced.

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      The main method starts the window. printConsoleBanner() runs first. Log4j is initialized from classpath:log4j2-shell.properties. A runtime failure from that initialize is ignored. AetherisYaml.ensureHomeFile() writes the home file when it is absent. AetherisYaml.load(String[]) reads the arguments. SshClientProperties.load() reads the client file. SshClientProperties.saveIfFileMissing() writes a missing file. The theme defaults are installed before the window is created. The window is created and shown on the Swing thread.
      Parameters:
      args - The program arguments. AetherisYaml.load(String[]) reads them.

    • sessionConnected

      public void sessionConnected(TerminalSession session, SshTtyConnector connector, String host, int port)
      The sessionConnected method attaches a live connector. The terminal attaches the connector. aimSession(TerminalSession, SshTtyConnector) arms the listener when the connector speaks AMWP. A pane that is not focused only refreshes the Aetheris user list. The focused pane is selected. A connected connector applies FoldingPanel.Beat.CONNECTED. Any other result opens the connection fields. The remote server and the port are remembered. The terminal takes focus. The Aetheris tab is refreshed and may be restored. The focused user and the Aetheris user list are refreshed.
      Specified by:
      sessionConnected in interface TerminalSession.Host
      Parameters:
      session - The pane that connected.
      connector - The live connector. It may be null.
      host - The remote server address.
      port - The remote port.

    • sessionDisconnected

      public void sessionDisconnected(TerminalSession session, SshTtyConnector connector, String message)
      The sessionDisconnected method stops one pane. dropSession(TerminalSession, SshTtyConnector) drops the listener record. The terminal stops the session. A pane that is not focused only refreshes the Aetheris user list. The focused pane is selected and the Aetheris tab is refreshed. A null message sets the status to disconnected. A blank message sets the status to disconnected. Any other message is stored as Disconnected: plus the message. That message is also shown in a warning dialog titled Disconnected. The focused user is refreshed.
      Specified by:
      sessionDisconnected in interface TerminalSession.Host
      Parameters:
      session - The pane that disconnected.
      connector - The connector captured before it was cleared.
      message - The disconnect reason. A null or blank value shows no dialog.

    • sessionError

      public void sessionError(TerminalSession session, SshTtyConnector connector, String message)
      The sessionError method reports a failed connection. dropSession(TerminalSession, SshTtyConnector) drops the listener record. The terminal stops the session. A pane that is not focused only refreshes the Aetheris user list. The focused pane is selected. The link word becomes Disconnected: plus the message. The focused user and the Aetheris user list are refreshed. An error dialog titled Connection failed shows the message.
      Specified by:
      sessionError in interface TerminalSession.Host
      Parameters:
      session - The pane that failed.
      connector - The connector captured before it was cleared.
      message - The failure text.

    • relayArmedMoods

      public void relayArmedMoods()
      The relayArmedMoods method sends the console mood to connected AMWP panes. A missing notebook returns immediately. A pane that is not connected is skipped. A missing connector is skipped. A connector that is not AMWP is skipped. A missing username is skipped. MoodDesk.announceBody(boolean, String, String) builds the body from the told flag, the held mood, and the wanted line. A null body sends nothing. The body is written as UTF-8 on channel A. A successful write stores the wanted line and marks the mood as told. A null wanted line is stored as an empty string. A write failure is ignored. The status line is repainted after the loop. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md FINESSE:f-175 FINESSE:f-176
      Specified by:
      relayArmedMoods in interface AetherisNotebookPanel.Host

    • focusConnectedUser

      public void focusConnectedUser(String username)
      The focusConnectedUser method selects the pane for one vault user. A null username returns immediately. An empty username returns immediately. The name is passed through the vault name. A focused connected AMWP pane with that vault name is selected and the search stops. Otherwise the first other connected AMWP pane with that vault name is selected. No match leaves the focus unchanged.

      public File chooseRememberedFile(Component parent)
      The chooseRememberedFile method opens the remembered file dialog. A stored directory is used when it is a directory. Approve records the selected file. Cancel records no file. A cancel, or a null file, returns null.

      The aetherisVaultShown method finishes opening a vault. A missing focus returns immediately. A focus that is not connected returns immediately. A username that is not the open username returns immediately. A last request that is not that open user returns immediately. An AMWP connector is aimed at the username. Pending work for that username is applied. The run for that username is shown.

      public void sendTerminalPaste(String text) throws IOException
      The sendTerminalPaste method sends a paste to the focused pane. A missing focus throws IOException with no terminal. A missing connector throws that same exception. The text is normalized. A text longer than MAX_PASTE_CHARS throws IOException. That message starts with Paste exceeds . Any other text is sent as a paste.
      Specified by:
      sendTerminalPaste in interface AetherisNotebookPanel.Host
      Parameters:
      text - The paste text.
